title: Chick
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Egg shell bottom -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="28" ry="16" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="28" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#e8d4a8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Zigzag egg top edge -->
  <path d="M22 72 L30 62 L38 72 L46 62 L54 72 L62 62 L70 72 L78 72" fill="#f5e6c8" stroke="#e8d4a8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M22 72 L78 72 L78 94 L22 94 Z" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="28" ry="16" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <path d="M22 72 L30 62 L38 72 L46 62 L54 72 L62 62 L70 72 L78 72" fill="none" stroke="#e8d4a8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Chick body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#ffdf3c"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="22" ry="20" fill="none" stroke="#e8c020" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Wings -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="54" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#f5c800" transform="rotate(15 28 54)"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="54" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#f5c800" transform="rotate(-15 72 54)"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="18" fill="#ffdf3c"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#e8c020" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Hair tuft -->
  <path d="M46 17 Q48 10 50 15 Q52 8 54 16 Q56 11 54 19" fill="none" stroke="#e8c020" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="32" r="3.5" fill="#3a2a00"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="32" r="3.5" fill="#3a2a00"/>
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="30.5" r="1.2" fill="#fff8d0"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="30.5" r="1.2" fill="#fff8d0"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9e7a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="38" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9e7a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M47 38 L50 44 L53 38 Z" fill="#ff8c00"/>
  <path d="M47 38 L50 41 L53 38" fill="#cc6600" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M40 82 L36 90 M40 82 L40 91 M40 82 L44 90" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 82 L56 90 M60 82 L60 91 M60 82 L64 90" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
